==Notes==
*The damage is delivered in three independent packets. Adjacent foes are hit three times, nearby foes twice, and foes in the area only once.
**One-time [[damage reduction]] skills, such as [[Reversal of Fortune]], and damage cappers, such [[Protective Spirit]], do not fully protect against this skill, however skills that protect against multiple packets, such as [[Union]], are more effective.
**[[Pain Inverter]] will deal damage back for each packet.
*Cracked Armor is applied before any damage.
{{anomaly|The skill description implies that Blind [[cover]]s Cracked Armor which covers Weakness, while in actuality Blind covers Weakness which covers Cracked Armor.}}

==Trivia==
*This is one of only two [[Condition#Skills that can inflict two or more conditions|player skills that can generate three new conditions]] without spreading them from other foes (the other being [[Virulence]]).
